benchmark.profileSearchInvalidMeasuremen: Check measurement settings: positive token counts, 1–20 runs, room for the answer within minimum context, and accuracy from 0 to 100%.
benchmark.profileSearchDescription: Maximum context, maximum generation speed, and balance. A minimum of 65,536 tokens per session applies to every profile. The app tests long input, measures generation, and saves passing configurations.
benchmark.profileSearchLimits: llama.cpp: one slot, fixed context, KV and batch variants. Search is limited by this range and the known model context limit. Tests can take a long time and restart the server. Cancellation follows the current operation; the original server is restored. Winners are selected from tested candidates.
benchmark.profileSearchInvalidRange: Minimum must be at least 65,536; maximum must be at least the minimum and no more than 1,048,576 tokens.
benchmark.selectedProfilesDescription: Profiles were saved separately and the original launch was restored. Speed is measured with a generation test; context is checked with long input and a stability test. Multiple goals may use the same configuration.
benchmark.profileSearchUnavailable: Profile search is unavailable: check the range (65,536–1,048,576), model context limit, and support for --ctx-size, --parallel, --fit. Remove context, slot, fit, KV, and batch overrides from extra arguments.
benchmark.restoringBeforeSave: Restoring the original server before saving profiles
benchmark.autoProfileDescription: Automatic selection: context {{contextTokens}}, generation {{speed}} tok/s. Measurement: {{benchmarkId}}. Stability verification: {{verificationId}}.
benchmark.profileSaveFailed: Could not save all selected profiles or refresh routes: {{error}}

router.title: Model router
router.description: Start llama-server as an OpenAI-compatible router. Saved profile names become API model IDs; llama.cpp loads the requested profile and unloads older models when the loaded-model limit is reached.
router.toolsCompatibility: Router mode enables --jinja for every profile, which Harness requests with tools require. A saved jinja=false value is overridden in the router preset.
router.modeHelp: Router mode publishes saved profiles through one API endpoint. Single-model mode starts only the selected profile.
router.hostHelp: Use 127.0.0.1 for this PC only, or a LAN address to accept Harness requests from other devices.
router.maximumHelp: Default is 1. When the limit is reached, llama.cpp unloads an inactive model before loading the requested profile.
router.autoloadHelp: When enabled, a request using its profile name loads that model on demand.
router.apiKeyHelp: Generated and stored locally by Aplot Control LLM. Copy this key into the API client that connects to the router.
router.restartNeeded: Saved router settings take effect after the next start or restart.
router.modelIdCopied: Copied model ID “{{name}}” for use in the Harness model field.
router.modelIdCopyFailed: Could not copy the API model ID.
router.invalidPort: Router port must be a whole number from 1 to 65535.
router.invalidMaximum: Maximum loaded models must be a whole number from 1 to 64.
router.unsupportedBuild: The selected llama-server build does not support model router mode. Choose a build with --models-preset, --models-max, and --models-autoload.
router.apiKeyRequiredForNetwork: Set a shared API key before binding the router to a network address.
router.unsupportedParameterCount: Some profile options are not supported by this llama.cpp build ({{count}}).
router.commandHelp: The preset is generated from saved profiles. The Run button passes the API key from Settings to the managed process.
metrics.generationRateHelp: The rate over the latest interval changes in real time. Strata logs show the average since the first token; it is displayed below. Rates are summed for parallel requests.
metrics.ttftHelp: Streaming TTFT is measured during benchmarks. The /health, /metrics, and /slots polling endpoints do not expose it.
capability.optionUnsupported: This option is not supported by the detected llama.cpp build.

benchmark.live.title: Live benchmark monitor

benchmark.live.noEvents: Stages and results will appear here after starting.
benchmark.plan.title: Test plan and scoring
benchmark.plan.search: Each candidate: throughput → fact recall → multi-window stability. Only verified profiles are saved.
benchmark.plan.targets: Recommendations also check the requested quality threshold of {{threshold}}% and minimum speed when set. Throughput alone does not measure answer quality.
benchmark.plan.throughput.name: Throughput
benchmark.plan.throughput.description: Prompt processing, generation and time to first token.
benchmark.plan.throughput.score: tok/s, ms, RAM and VRAM; no answer-quality score.
benchmark.plan.recall.name: Exact recall
benchmark.plan.recall.description: Retrieve random key/code pairs from a long context.
benchmark.plan.recall.score: Exact matches / expected pairs. Suite threshold: {{threshold}}% per window.
benchmark.plan.carryover.name: Memory continuity
benchmark.plan.carryover.description: Recover previous-window facts from a checkpoint, starting with window two.
benchmark.plan.carryover.score: Retained pairs / expected pairs. Threshold: {{threshold}}%. Not scored in window one.
benchmark.plan.compaction.name: Checkpoint compression
benchmark.plan.compaction.description: Create a JSON checkpoint preserving the current key/code pairs.
benchmark.plan.compaction.score: Exact pairs ≥ {{threshold}}%; output ≤ {{max}} tokens (including suite allowance).
